title: Pairwise additivity to four particles at rest, separations 3 to 5, species A, B, C (T <= 1)

claims.statement: Four particles at rest on a 3 x 4 rectangle (species A, B, C, A; sides 3 and 4, diagonals 5), T = 1: the pairwise sum over all partners of the P-0005 sep-5 coefficients, with no three-body or four-body term, reproduces the tracker positions of all four particles at tracker-noise level. Residual rms 0.050 to 0.051 per coordinate, max |mean residual| 0.004, no census events (2026-11-19/r2/lab-b/001). Checked independently with out/papers/P-0008/model.py.

Three particles at rest with mixed species A, B, C and pairwise separations 3, 4 and 5 (two arrangements), and an equilateral A, B, C triangle of side 3, T = 1: the same pairwise sum reproduces the tracker positions at tracker-noise level, residual rms 0.050 per coordinate in all three runs, max |mean residual| 0.005, no census events (2026-11-19/r1/lab-b/006, 2026-11-19/r1/lab-b/007, 2026-11-18/r3/lab-b/006).
